notes.title: Saber Ship Demo: Beat the core to win the official version
notes.notes:
How to get in: Return the score and the link to the current game video to the Steam community on this activity.

The way to get the key: The 5 players with the highest score will be selected after the time is up, and the key will be sent out after adding friends through the Steam community.

Note: The game process in the video should be intact and the final score should be clearly visible. A player can only get one game key.
